adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the call `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` passes `credentialId` as the third argument. But `refreshOAuthTokens` is defined as `(refreshFunction, appSlug, userId: number | null)` and, in sharing mode, sends that value as `calcomUserId` in the POST body. Passing a credential ID instead of `credential.userId` would cause the external sync endpoint to receive the wrong identifier and likely fail user lookup or map to the wrong entity.
